tweets.text: Travis County is paying DC lawyers $60,000 so DA José Garza can answer a congressional records request. Congress wants 5 years of files on how Garza’s office handled immigrant defendants, including cases where convictions got reduced or suspiciously wiped to soften immigration consequences. If the records show nothing wrong, he can just hand them over. Instead the county is protecting him by going shopping for expensive lawyers in DC on taxpayer dime. DC is learning what concerned Austin citizens have experienced since 2021, which is that it's never easy getting documents from Garza's office.
